notFound.title: This dial doesn't exist
notFound.text: Dial numbers start from 1. Go back to your dials and pick one.

header.liveHint: Exactly what the dial is showing right now
header.previewHint: How this page will look on the dial, including changes you haven't saved
header.profileHint: Each profile can show something different on this dial.
header.notActive: Right now the dials follow the profile “{{name}}”: what you set here shows up when this profile becomes active.

create.title: Dial {{slot}} has nothing to show in “{{profile}}”
create.inherit: While this profile is active, the dial shows what the default profile “{{name}}” gives it. Create its own setup to show something else.
create.idle: While this profile is active, the dial stays idle.
create.idleDefault: The dial stays idle until you give it something to show.
create.copyHint: Start from the default profile's pages and change only what you need.
create.emptyHint: One page with the standard look: pick a sensor and you're done.

color.whiteHint: Adds the separate white LED: softer, warmer pastel tones.

data.label: Title on the face
data.labelHint: Leave it empty to use the sensor's name.
data.noSensor: No sensor yet: the needle rests at zero.
data.rangeHint: Which values sit at the two ends of the dial. Leave the limits empty to use the sensor's suggestion.

logarithmic.label: Logarithmic
logarithmic.description: Opens up small values: network, disks

custom.label: Custom
custom.description: Put each value where you want it

data.pointsHint: Each value sits at its position along the dial (0% is the left end, 100% the right end).
data.pointsTooFew: Add at least two points, otherwise the scale stays linear.
data.invertHint: The needle moves from right to left.
data.movementHint: How the needle reacts when the value changes.

ppm.label: Peak meter
ppm.description: Jumps to peaks, falls back slowly

data.holdHint: How long a peak stays before falling
data.speedHint: How fast the physical needle travels to its target.
data.offlineHint: What the dial does if the sensor stops sending values.

zero.label: Back to zero
zero.description: The needle returns to the start

hold.label: Keep the last value
hold.description: The needle stays where it was

dim.label: Zero and dim
dim.description: Needle to zero and the light dimmed

light.modeHint: How the color behind the face is chosen.
light.offHint: The backlight stays off. Alarms can still light it up.
light.thresholdsHint: From each value upwards the light takes that color.
light.noThresholds: No thresholds yet: the light keeps the color above.

sensor.label: Color sensor
sensor.description: Any sensor that publishes a color

light.fallbackHint: Used while the source has no color.
light.outputHint: Applied on top of the color, before night mode.
light.depthHint: How much the light dims at its lowest point.
light.nowHint: The color the dial is showing.
light.nowOther: The dial is showing another page or profile right now.
light.alarmsHint: Take over the light when a value crosses a threshold, and notify you if you like.

alarm.title: Alarm {{index}}
alarm.pageValueHint: Threshold in the page's display unit.
alarm.sensorHint: Threshold in the sensor's own unit.
alarm.hysteresisHint: Clears only once the value is this far back

pages.rotationHint: With more than one page, the dial cycles through them.
pages.noRotation: 0 means no automatic rotation: change page from your dials.
pages.singlePage: Add a second page to start rotating.
pages.listHint: Each page has its own data, face and light.
pages.name: Name
pages.lastPage: A dial needs at least one page
pages.removeInherit: The dial will go back to what the default profile “{{name}}” shows.
pages.removeIdle: The dial will stay idle while this profile is active.
pages.removeConfirm_one: Delete its page? You can still discard the change before saving.
pages.removeConfirm_other: Delete its {{count}} pages? You can still discard the change before saving.
